comment: The files of this app's own build whose names may stay in an error report's stack. A name can carry a place, and a pattern can't tell the app's from one that does, so a frame's file is kept only if it is listed here: 'bases' are the chunk names before Vite's eight-character hash (app-BrmPk3gH.js is 'app'), 'fixed' are the files that keep their names. web/scripts/check-dist.mjs fails the build when it makes a file that isn't covered, so a new chunk can't quietly lose its frames' file names. Add it here.
